review_method: Root agent directly viewed each original PNG with view_image.

observations: English objective heading and visible story text are readable and stay inside the scroll region. Lower task instructions and locator buttons require scrolling; this image does not show all seven buttons simultaneously.
Command bar remains inside the screenshot. Show Info and Items controls are fully visible; portrait, health and selected-unit icons do not overlap them.
Ruan Xiaoqi name and health are fully readable; the single selected portrait is visible.
World labels around unconscious escorts can overlap and some units are partly obscured. These remain presentation observations, not proof of a blocked transport click.
